answer: Producing a novel, coherent answer each epoch is cheap per alias but prohibitive across thousands, so scale buys less credibility — the attacker cannot simply buy a large, credible flock. This means an attacker must choose: either run a few high-quality identities, or many worthless ones — and neither option beats honest participation.. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. Consider a lotus as the anchor of the cost.
